title: cyclosorus deltipterus
intro: Cyclosorus deltipterus, commonly known as the Chinese Leptosporangiate, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus deltipterus are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
